text: The Pullman car back to London
why: ¶215 says they had the corner of a Pullman car to themselves as they went back to London.

text: The evening of the race, in a Pullman car back to London
why: ¶215 places it 'that evening', after the race, in a Pullman car bound for London.

text: Holmes's account of the Monday night
why: ¶215 says they listened to Holmes's narrative of the events at the stables on the Monday night.
¶84 already mentions the milliner's account made out by Madame Lesurier of Bond Street.
